svg.title: dsh-attendance-check day-state cascade
svg.desc: Six short-circuit gates judge each punch row into one day state; issues are ranked 30/25/20/10 and the monthly cap is checked separately; the audit exits as attendance.summary and attendance.export.

text.font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Source Han Sans SC',sans-serif
Consolas,'Cascadia Mono','SFMono-Regular',ui-monospace,monospace
'Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Source Han Sans SC',sans-serif

svg.text: Six short-circuit gates in evaluateRecord order — yes → state, no ↓ next gate. Issues never abort; only bad CSV, date, time, break or policy do.
